purpose: Add a terminal-launched windowed operator launcher with separate aquarium log pane and Copy/Clear buttons.
ui_requirements: every action streams visible output into the log pane
every action still writes SUPPORT/TUI logs/receipts through underlying console TUI
hard_laws: No git commit or git push action.
Windowed launcher is an operator shell, not IDE visual abstraction.
Aquarium log must be copyable and clearable.
